flags.sentence: Pia arrived first among the five riders, rolling in well before dawn to check her bicycle and stretch along the towpath.
flags.reason: This describes arrival order, but combined with 'arrived first' it could be read as implying finishing rank; however arrival is a distinct attribute from finish rank, so this is filler, not a leak — excluded.

flags.sentence: Alma nodded along, watching the last few stragglers cross the line before the afternoon wound down peacefully.
flags.reason: This implies Alma is overseeing/observing the race finish in an authoritative capacity, hinting at her being the head judge.
